title: Integrated Simulation Model for Preliminary Aerodynamic, Structural, and Control-Law Design of Aircraft
author: Mark Drela
finding: Quarter-chord circulation and circulation-rate lift/moment, plus b=2/pi and C=(1+2ik)/(1+4ik), are already printed in 1999. This supplies no evidence for changing the current lag coefficient to match the later Daedalus Bode plot.
qualification: The paper also discusses a convected shed-vorticity integral before presenting the local lag approximation. It does not identify the exact Daedalus 2008 executable settings or prove every version used identical implementation details.
